title: FAI_WinOP profili
description: DOCUMENTATION / editor support. The real validation is in src/Core/Schema.ps1 (Get-FaiProfileError); Windows PowerShell 5.1 has no Test-Json. The allowed field names are kept identical in both (checked by tests/Unit/Schema.Tests.ps1).

name.description: Profile name: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen.

tweaks.description: Tweaks to apply, in this order. A duplicate ID is an error.

params.description: Overrides the tweak's Params defaults (a name not defined in the tweak is an error).

autoConfirm.description: Caution tweaks to apply without confirmation in -Unattended mode (must be in the tweaks list). A risk level is never auto-confirmed.

apps.description: Apps to install (apps/catalog.json IDs), before the tweaks, in this order. A duplicate ID is an error.

keepAutostart.description: Do not apply the catalog's rule that turns off autostart (e.g. WhatsApp, Telegram).

games.description: Phase 7 (gaming.per-game): per-game priority (IFEO CpuPriorityClass) and processor affinity (startup task). Masks are computed from the machine's logical processor / core count. Applied after the tweaks and before the layout.

exe.description: File name only (e.g. cs2.exe), not a path.

smtOff.description: Only the first logical processor of each physical core.

excludeCore0.description: The logical processors of core 0 are not used.

layout.description: Phase 6: taskbar / desktop / Start layout (written by -ExportLayout). Applied after the tweaks as the 'layout.profile' tweak; -Undo reverts it. Every field is optional.

pins.description: Pins in order; those not in the list are removed.

link.description: Path of the shortcut in the Start menu, with environment variables (%ProgramData%\...).

flags.description: Bags\1\Desktop FFlags (1 = auto arrange, 4 = align to grid).

iconLayouts.description: Icon positions (IconLayouts, base64). Contains desktop item names.

appId.description: App ID in apps/catalog.json, e.g. chrome

tweakId.description: Tweak ID in category.name form, e.g. sound.startup-sound-off
